FULL TEXT:
STATE ELIGIBILITY TEST (SET) FOR ASSISTANT PROFESSORSHIP
TO BE CONDUCTED BY
SAVITRIBAI PHULE PUNE UNIVERSITY (formerly University of Pune)
THE NODAL AGENCY NOMINATED BY THE GOVERNMENT OF MAHARASHTRA & GOA
AND ACCREDITED BY U.G.C., NEW DELHI
Savitribai Phule Pune University, the State Agency will conduct 41st SET examination at
centres located in the cities Mumbai, Pune, Kolhapur, Solapur, Ahilyanagar, Nasik, Dhule,
Jalgaon, Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, Nanded, Amravati, Nagpur, Chandrapur, Gadchiroli,
Ratnagiri, Parbhani, Nandurbar & Panjim (Goa) on Sunday, 26th July, 2026. The examination
application forms will be available only “online” on the website https://setexam.unipune.ac.in
from 2nd June, 2026 at 11.00 a.m. onwards to 16th June, 2026 till 6.00 p.m. with regular fee.
Period for submitting online Application form with late fee will be 17th June, 2026 at 11.00
a.m. onwards to 19th June, 2026 till 6.00 p.m.
Candidates should fill up the online application form correctly and submit it online.
Printout of the Online Application form should be retained by the candidate and should not be
sent to any Co-ordinating Centre or to SET Department, Savitribai Phule Pune University.
EXAMINATION FEE (Including form Processing Fee)
Category Regular Fee Late Fee
i) OPEN Rs. 800/- Rs. 1,300/-
ii)OBC/DT(A)(VJ)/NT(B)/NT(C)/NT(D)/
SEBC/(for Non Creamy Layer)*/
Open(EWS)/ PwD/SC/ST/Trans-gender/
Orphan
Rs. 650/- Rs. 1,150/-
[
(Note:- * For annual income limit for Non Creamy Layer group please refer
latest Maharashtra Govt. Resolution of Dept. of Social Justice and
Special Assistance. In this regard, the rules prescribed by Goa Govt. will
be binding on Goa State students. )
A candidate must keep printout of application form. Candidates have to pay
examination fees by Debit/Credit Card or through Internet Banking or UPI & keep evidence of
the same.
The List of candidates who have paid SET examination fee on or before last date
will be displayed tentatively in the Second week of July, 2026 on the above website. The
Candidates whose names are missing even after payment of fees should send evidence of
payment immediately on the email id:- set-support @pun.unipune.ac.in
Information Bulletin of SET Examination and syllabi are available on the website
“https://setexam.unipune.ac.in”.
N.B. :- If a candidate is already SET qualified in a particular subject, he/she can not
appear for this SET in the same subject.
Sd/-
Prof.(Dr.) Prafulla Pawar
Offtg. Registrar & Member Secretary (SET)
